target.definition: A new official NOAA/SWPC >=10 MeV, >=10 pfu event onset in (issue_time, issue_time+24h].
target.labels: Official NOAA/SWPC event start and end intervals only; predictor fluxes never define labels.
target.construct_overlap_warning: Differential proton predictors are instrument-adjacent to the proton-event target. Gains are incremental predictive association, not proof of a new upstream physical precursor.

issues.role_edge_rule: Both full predictor and outcome windows must remain inside one role; enforce a 24-hour purge at every role boundary.

roles.common_coverage_rule: The source gate may narrow only interval edges using source timestamps before labels are read. Boundaries may not move to increase event support.

forbidden: manually associated flare or CME fields

models.primary: Fixed five-seed XGBoost using XRS plus bound SGPS differential features; median probability across seeds; n_estimators=300, learning_rate=0.03, max_depth=3, min_child_weight=5, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=1.0, reg_alpha=0.0, tree_method=hist; seeds 7,13,26,42,73.

calibration_and_threshold.calibration: One intercept-only probability correction fit on calibration role only.
calibration_and_threshold.primary_threshold: Maximize TSS on threshold role only; ties choose the highest threshold.
calibration_and_threshold.secondary_diagnostic: Among threshold-role points with POD >=0.80, choose minimum FAR; descriptive only.

evaluation.abstention_rule: A positive-event abstention counts as missed/unwarned; never silently drop it.

predeclared_utility_gate.comparison: primary joint model versus best simple available-input comparator on identical eligible issues

execution_sequence: complete labels and support gate must pass
freeze exact input manifest, hashes, eligible issues and role boundaries
independent verifier recomputes receipt and paired metrics
